races.name: North Wales Business Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HOE JOLY SMOKE has never really been one for maximum faith but this looks a good piece of placing by his leading stable back hurdling on return from a break. Iamyouare should ensure the selection is kept honest.

  1. HOE JOLY SMOKE
  2. IAMYOUARE (IRE)
  3. SOVEREIGNLIGHTCAFE

races.name: Genesis Wealth Management Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
It's very hard to get away from DELGANY SECOND NOW who can get the hat-trick up if taking to chasing after smooth wins over hurdles for his leading yard. Soldier In Mayo is likely to pose the main threat if ready to go after a long absence, while Rockvale probably has a race like this in him.

  1. DELGANY SECOND NOW
  2. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE)
  3. ROCKVALE (IRE)

races.name: Goffs Yorton Sale 10th September Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It could be worth giving TAMARIND BAY another chance despite the presence of Dan Skelton's thriving Thickthorn Tom, who hasn't always looked the heartiest. Mickey Bowen's charge would probably have made it 3-3 over fences if standing up at Perth and can rate higher.

  1. TAMARIND BAY (IRE)
  2. THICKTHORN TOM (IRE)
  3. REGAL RENAISSANCE

races.name: DU Construction Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ERNEST GRAY has a 5 lb pull with Kiwi de Cotte on their Market Rasen clash and while that rival possesses the scope to go on again, Alan King's charge is weighted to come out on top this time. Secret Trix has been knocking on the door and will doubtless make his presence felt again.

  1. ERNEST GRAY (IRE)
  2. KIWI DE COTTE (FR)
  3. SECRET TRIX

races.name: Kinsey Anniversary Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Having chased home a subsequent scorer on her return at Uttoxeter in July, JAMMY JAY was far from disgraced when fourth in a stronger race back at that venue 6 weeks ago and she's fancied to open her account back down in grade. I Heard A Rumour has an unexposed profile for the Skeltons and any confidence behind her on return/handicap debut would be noteworthy.

  1. JAMMY JAY
  2. I HEARD A RUMOUR (IRE)
  3. NORTHERN ROSE (IRE)

races.name: Lexus Wrexham Open 2026 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A winner in points since last seen under Rules in Ireland, DEPALMA is clearly a fascinating runner for the Dan Skelton yard (bought for £20,000 in May) and could well be worth chancing to immediately repay some of the investment on just his second start over fences. Harrys Hope is evidently on a good mark and feared for all her weak finishing tendencies remain a cause for concern. The consistent Ridin Solo can also feature on his first crack at 3m.

  1. DEPALMA (IRE)
  2. HARRYS HOPE (IRE)
  3. RIDIN SOLO (IRE)

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Having justified good support when successful on debut for Dan Skelton at Uttoxeter, ASHDOWN FOREST fared best of those held up in a messy race when third behind Ballynoe Boy at Market Rasen 3 weeks ago. He's well worth another chance to prove his revised mark a workable one and emerge victorious this time. La Lolita and Lucky in Taipan are others worth a second look.

  1. ASHDOWN FOREST (IRE)
  2. BALLYNOE BOY (IRE)
  3. LA LOLITA (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JET SMART looks worth another try over staying distances (placed in point and related to fairly useful stayer), and he gets the nod in a tricky opener. Paper Mill has solid form claims, while Mumford's Magic (goes well fresh) will be a threat if his jumping holds up.

  1. JET SMART (IRE)
  2. PAPER MILL
  3. MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)

races.name: Kevin 'Nasty' Turner Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HOLY LEGEND is enjoying a purple patch and may well make it 3 wins from 4 starts this summer. Culligran is a fairly solid operator at this level and looks a danger, while Belle Le Grand needs close monitoring in the market.

  1. HOLY LEGEND
  2. CULLIGRAN (IRE)
  3. BELLE LE GRAND

races.name: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BRAVE LION has an appealing pedigree for a yard which has an excellent record in bumpers, so he's taken to make a successful start to his career. Ebarayna stuck to her task admirably when second on her debut at Uttoxeter and has since changed hands for £45,000, while Spanish Darling should improve on his recent C&D third, particularly if granted a stronger gallop.

  1. BRAVE LION
  2. EBARAYNA
  3. SPANISH DARLING (FR)

races.name: John Burke Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good opportunity for ELATED to make amends for her late fall here last month. Steal A Glance is most likely to chase her home following an improved showing at Stratford, while point winner Jury Roses could be interesting if supported on Rules debut.

  1. ELATED
  2. STEAL A GLANCE
  3. JURY ROSES (IRE)

races.name: Step Into Luxury With Purple Granite Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Still early days for TILEHURST and Emerald Time in handicaps, with both having won over C&D this summer. Sean Bowen's mount is narrowly preferred to make it 2-2 in cheekpieces, while Sun Art is dangerous to dismiss in a race that could become tactical.

  1. TILEHURST
  2. EMERALD TIME
  3. SUN ART (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Once-promising novice hurdler THAT'S NICE gets the vote on her return to hurdling. Handlethekettle is respected in his bid to maintain an unbeaten course record, while Theatre Tom and Harry also need considering in an open-looking contest.

  1. THAT'S NICE (IRE)
  2. HANDLETHEKETTLE (IRE)
  3. THEATRE TOM (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Saturday's Racing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SONYOURASTAR makes plenty of appeal for the excellent Olly Murphy/Sean Bowen combination. Low-mileage 8-y-o Fane Court looks a danger following his near miss here last time, along with Citizen Jane, who travelled well when second over C&D on her most recent start.

  1. SONYOURASTAR (IRE)
  2. FANE COURT (IRE)
  3. CITIZEN JANE

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SONTSIVKA was sent off favourite when shaping well in second on debut at Newmarket 3 weeks ago, really getting the hang of things by the end, and he can go one better with improvement on the way. Greenlander and Hidden Beyond also made encouraging starts at this venue and will progress, while Yuzuru might be the pick of the newcomers.

  1. SONTSIVKA
  2. GREENLANDER (IRE)
  3. HIDDEN BEYOND (AUS)

races.name: Unibet/EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HUWA BAREE knew his job when making a winning start at Lingfield last month and with improvement on the cards quickly upped to 1m, Charlie Johnston's colt gets the vote to remain unbeaten at the expense of Peaberry, who forced the all-the-way winner to work close home at Wolverhampton recently and remains with potential. Celtic Storm and Lunar Blossom can fight out third.

  1. HUWA BAREE (USA)
  2. PEABERRY
  3. CELTIC STORM (FR)

races.name: Irish EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The well-bred GILDING THE LILY confirmed the considerable promise shown when runner up on debut at Wolverhampton when opening her account in a Newmarket novice 3 weeks ago and with potential for better still intact, she's fancied to defy a penalty and make it 2-3. Star Mirage can emerge as the lead danger back in novice company.

  1. GILDING THE LILY
  2. STAR MIRAGE (USA)
  3. RIVER NILE (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
SUGGY is rapidly going the right way on all-weather and could well resume winning ways returned to this surface. Fallacious Promise is another with a superb all-weather record and could be a threat if coping with a hike in grade, while Starlight Time was a winner here just last month and is respected.

  1. SUGGY
  2. FALLACIOUS PROMISE
  3. STARLIGHT TIME

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
KINIRO has caught the eye a few times this year and a truly-run contest could bring the best out of him so he's taken to break his duck for current yard. Philanthropist is another major player given his stable's excellent form and Mythical Composer is one that could get back on the up returned to all-weather.

  1. KINIRO
  2. PHILANTHROPIST
  3. MYTHICAL COMPOSER

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap
races.verdict:
NEWSREADER shaped well when fourth at Ffos Las last month on his first outing for new connections and can make his mark for a yard that excels with new recruits. Early Release is a dual C&D winner returning to a favoured track and is always a threat if getting his way out in front, while Peter The Wolf drops back in trip and grade which makes him of some interest.

  1. NEWSREADER (IRE)
  2. EARLY RELEASE
  3. PETER THE WOLF

races.name: Industry Leading In-Play Markets At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
EDUCATOR has won his last 2 starts and, while he had to work harder under a penalty at Newmarket 29 days ago, he's proven at this longer trip and could bring up the hat-trick. Urban Warrior got off the mark at Yarmouth 30 days ago with first-time cheekpieces doing the trick and could be hard to peg back if getting his way out in front, while Must Believe has a solid all-weather record.

  1. EDUCATOR
  2. URBAN WARRIOR
  3. MUST BELIEVE

races.name: Racing To School Celebrates 25 Years Lady Amateur Jockeys Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
DANNICK runs off 1 lb lower than when scoring with something to spare at Lingfield 10 days ago so should take a bit of stopping if showing up here in similar form. Tex went close at Brighton last time, despite hanging into the camber, and this recent 7f course winner is feared most ahead of Irish raider Little Empire.

  1. DANNICK
  2. TEX (FR)
  3. LITTLE EMPIRE (IRE)

races.name: Charbonnel et Walker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An entry in the Royal Lodge at the end of the month points to KORSAKOV being well regarded by his top stable so he gets the nod to make a winning debut, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Newbury fourth San Jose is the other one in this line-up with Group entries and is second choice ahead of Kempton runner-up Chymbulak. The other newcomers from leading stables would also need considering if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. KORSAKOV
  2. SAN JOSE (IRE)
  3. CHYMBULAK (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Events EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race) (Rnd)
races.verdict:
The standard set by those with experience isn't that high so this could well go to one of the newcomers, all of whom have something to recommend them on paper. CLAUDETTE gets the nod for the Gosdens' ahead of Divide And Conquer and Comrade Alexi but this is a race where the betting seems sure to be informative.

  1. CLAUDETTE (FR)
  2. DIVIDE AND CONQUER (IRE)
  3. COMRADE ALEXI (IRE)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PURE MINT powered clear to justify market support on his Ripon debut and this seemingly well-regarded colt (Group 2 entered) is taken to make light of his penalty, perhaps at the expense of Lingfield runner-up Brushstroke. Does Mary Know also enters calculations.

  1. PURE MINT (IRE)
  2. BRUSHSTROKE
  3. DOES MARY KNOW

races.name: Big Ascot Food & Wine Festival Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
MALACHY'S WISH has progressed well on the all-weather of late and having broken his maiden on turf last season, is fancied to translate that improvement back onto this surface. Bunbury Cup winner Aalto ran well in the International here last time and is also shortlisted alongside the hat-trick seeking Jonny Concrete.

  1. MALACHY'S WISH
  2. AALTO (FR)
  3. JONNY CONCRETE (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Hospitality Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
HARD ENDEAVOUR is less exposed than most here and can progress again from his promising Sandown second to land this good prize. Course specialist Hickory is also shortlisted, with his win here in July looking strong form, whilst Ozat hasn't had the rub of the green on his most recent outings and likely remains on a competitive mark.

  1. HARD ENDEAVOR (FR)
  2. HICKORY (IRE)
  3. OZAT (FR)

races.name: Sodexo Live! Handicap
races.verdict:
FIRST LEGION has been running respectably in stronger races than this and can capitalise on the drop in grade back at 7f, with Raging Raj, who has continued in good form after a stable switch, and the front-running Irish raider Hambelton also strongly considered.

  1. FIRST LEGION (IRE)
  2. RAGING RAJ (IRE)
  3. HAMBELTON (IRE)

races.name: Thomas Armstrong Group Haydock Park Training Series Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ZIMMERMAN probably benefited from being taken very wide in the back straight when belatedly taking advantage of a much-reduced mark at Ripon on Tuesday, but he still scored with notable ease and is the percentage call to follow up under a penalty. Dance Time has yet to win this year but there's no reason why she shouldn't give another good account. Yellow Card has been in good form over hurdles during the summer and isn't taken lightly reverting to this code, either.

  1. ZIMMERMAN
  2. DANCE TIME
  3. YELLOW CARD

races.name: Lee Thomas Christy Memorial EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not the easiest novice to assess but Hugo Palmer's Almanzor newcomer MY GIRL DEE MO appeals on paper and holds an entry in the Group 1 Fillies' Mile so gets the vote. Princess Lottie should find this step up to 1m in her favour and appeals as the main danger.

  1. MY GIRL DEE MO (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS LOTTIE
  3. GIRL SCOUT

races.name: Tattersalls 40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ETONNANTE found a well-up-to-scratch Group 2 beyond her at Newmarket in July but she's back down in calmer waters here on the back of a breathing operation and can defy a penalty. Marsala is the marginal forecast pick.

  1. ETONNANTE (IRE)
  2. MARSALA (IRE)
  3. CALIFORNIAN ANGEL

races.name: Oakmere Homes Handicap
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff but KODI LION can boast a very positive Haydock record and now 3 lb below his last winning mark, he looks weighted to strike with Fallon taking over. Grant Wood shaped well at Ripon last time so demands respect, while handicap debutant Tip Foster brings a different profile to the table.

  1. KODI LION (IRE)
  2. GRANT WOOD (IRE)
  3. TIP FOSTER

races.name: Aesterius At Bearstone Stud Handicap
races.verdict:
PARISIAC wasn't seen to anything like best effect at Hamilton last time and is fancied to capitalise on a lenient-looking mark now. Lipsink rates a big threat though on the back of a narrow Sandown reverse, while Accrual, Changeofmind and Creative Queen also need factoring into this open sprint.

  1. PARISIAC (IRE)
  2. LIPSINK (IRE)
  3. ACCRUAL

races.name: Arete Foundation Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open but it could pay to side with CLEMENTINES STAR who had looked on the up until not seen to best effect from a poor draw when third on her handicap bow at Chepstow. Recent Ffos Las scorer Cypriot Diaspora rates a big threat under a penalty though, while Dream Illusion, Imelda and Gelato can all play a prominent role too.

  1. CLEMENTINES STAR
  2. CYPRIOT DIASPORA
  3. DREAM ILLUSION

races.name: Betfair Supports Racing Welfare Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances. LESRICO returned from a break with an encouraging seventh to Naturalia at Ayr last month so could prove the answer here given he has a good record on soft ground. Donald Whillans' mare is feared most despite taking a 3 lb rise, although course winner Blue Wonder is weighted to go well if shrugging aside a lesser effort at Leicester.

  1. LESRICO
  2. NATURALIA
  3. BLUE WONDER (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOW'S ELLIE was still in front when crashing out at the final hurdle last time and can gain compensation here granted a better round of jumping. Ivatt showed fairly useful form on the Flat and should build on his third-placed hurdling debut at Tramore, while Astelia should be more competitive back in maiden company after disappointing at Galway.

  1. HOW'S ELLIE (IRE)
  2. IVATT
  3. ASTELIA (IRE)

races.name: Sean Daly Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COCOFRED is progressive, arrives on the back of a win and looks capable of taking another step forward now switched to handicap company. Hopeful Hero quickly got back on track last time and rates the main danger, while Splashing Out and Eye Of A Tiger are also capable of being involved if reproducing their best.

  1. COCOFRED (IRE)
  2. HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)
  3. SPLASHING OUT (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BOO RADLEY was poised to challenge when brought down at the last at Ballinrobe 25 days ago and is fancied to make amends granted better luck this time. Speed For Fun needs to iron out some rough edges but sets the standard on form and is likely to prove the main danger, while Maroel is entitled to improve on her recent hurdling debut.

  1. BOO RADLEY (IRE)
  2. SPEED FOR FUN (FR)
  3. MAROEL (IRE)

races.name: Sean Hughes Memorial 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ITSAWORKINMANIAM caught the eye when closing late on his Roscommon reappearance/handicap debut 31 days ago and, with the step up in trip expected to suit, looks worth chancing in an open-looking staying handicap. Mighty Berkshire arrives in good order and rates the main danger, while Sound Judgement remains unexposed as a stayer.

  1. ITSAWORKINMANIAM (IRE)
  2. MIGHTY BERKSHIRE (IRE)
  3. SOUND JUDGEMENT (IRE)

races.name: Midland Veterinary Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
LOS BLANCO jumped soundly on chasing debut at Wexford and, with improvement anticipated from a yard second to none with chasers, he is selected to come out on top. Fou de Toi found chasing more to his liking than hurdling when second at Ballinrobe and looks the chief threat, while chase debutant Manoir de Mirande is bred to excel in this sphere if able to keep his quirks in check.

  1. LOS BLANCO (FR)
  2. FOU DE TOI (FR)
  3. MANOIR DE MIRANDE (FR)

races.name: Kilsaran Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
PINOT GRIS posted a career best over hurdles at Galway last month and is expected to go close now returned to fences from a 6 lb lower mark. Hashtag Pretender showed a good attitude when opening his chase account at Roscommon last month despite several mistakes and is likely to prove the main danger if more assured in the jumping department and seeing out the trip. Charlie Luciano won at this course earlier in the summer and is also respected.

  1. PINOT GRIS (IRE)
  2. HASHTAG PRETENDER (FR)
  3. CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)

races.name: Clarke's Electrical Contractors, Castletown Geoghegan Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A small field but a case can be made for a few of these. Preference goes to MY GREAT MATE, who shaped as if better for the run on return at the Galway Festival recently and Willie Mullins' 7-y-o should have no issues with this markedly longer trip. Affinity Rock is proving consistent since sent chasing, so looks an obvious threat, with Chanceawetmorning an interesting chasing debutant, as well.

  1. MY GREAT MATE (IRE)
  2. AFFINITY ROCK (IRE)
  3. CHANCEAWETMORNING (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden
races.verdict:
BIT OF A BUZZ has the best form on offer and could be worth another chance if turned out quickly for this weak maiden. Tango Club looks interesting back over the minimum trip, while newcomer Monologue could be a danger if supported.

  1. BIT OF A BUZZ (IRE)
  2. TANGO CLUB (IRE)
  3. MONOLOGUE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
FORZA MAGICO has been shaping up well and ought to make it third time lucky. Otsana and Osterode both look credible dangers.

  1. FORZA MAGICO
  2. OTSANA (IRE)
  3. OSTERODE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
WHOSINTERVIEWINWHO left previous efforts behind when runner-up at Galway last month and with further progress in the pipeline, Andrew Slattery's colt can continue his yard's run of good form and get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Sovreigns Joy, who emerged as the best horse at the weights when finding one too strong at Leopardstown recently, with Letmeentertainyou rounding off the shortlist.

  1. WHOSINTERVIEWINWHO (IRE)
  2. SOVREIGNS JOY
  3. LETMEENTERTAINYOU (FR)

races.name: Grant Thornton Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
FINE LINE showed more than previously when fourth at Killarney a fortnight ago and with this return to 7f sure to be in her favour. Denis Hogan's filly earns a narrow vote to get off the mark. Elyatta failed to get competitive on nursery debut, but first-time blinkers may well eke out that bit extra, so he heads up the opposition, with Someday Somewhere and Romance taken to fight out third.

  1. FINE LINE (IRE)
  2. ELYATTA (IRE)
  3. SOMEDAY SOMEWHERE (IRE)

races.name: Grant Thornton Ulster Cesarewitch Handicap
races.verdict:
RAGMANS CORNER should see out this longer trip and can follow up in a lesser-grade handicap than he usually contests. Gangster Granny can't be ruled out given her recent form over hurdles, with Boxing Great and Trubshaw leading the remaining dangers.

  1. RAGMANS CORNER (IRE)
  2. GANGSTER GRANNY (IRE)
  3. BOXING GREAT (IRE)

races.name: Children's Heartbeat Trust Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Several hold claims and it's handicap debutant CHOSEN ONE who gets the nod to open her account. Hexagonal has run well off similar marks before and is entitled to be in the mix, while Darkdeserthighway shouldn't be too far away either.

  1. CHOSEN ONE (IRE)
  2. HEXAGONAL (IRE)
  3. DARKDESERTHIGHWAY (IRE)

races.name: Grant Thornton Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A wide-open handicap that can go the way of FLAGSTONE LADY, who's turned out again quickly having shaped very well at Roscommon. Limestone Red should be thereabouts again, with Maxwell Smart another one to consider.

  1. FLAGSTONE LADY (IRE)
  2. LIMESTONE RED (IRE)
  3. MAXWELL SMART (IRE)

races.name: Grant Thornton Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CONNECTEO should benefit from this drop back in trip and Andrew Oliver's gelding is taken to get off the mark. Noel Meade's Acanto is interesting now stepping into handicap company, with Mystic Rose completing the 1-2-3.

  1. CONNECTEO (IRE)
  2. ACANTO (IRE)
  3. MYSTIC ROSE (IRE)

Prix Du Carrefour Des Marchands De Navet Claiming Stakes
